title: ipomopsis aggregata var. maculata
intro: Ipomopsis aggregata var. maculata, commonly known as Skyrocket or Skyrocket Gilia, is a variety of the Ipomopsis aggregata plant species, which is native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is known for its bright red and yellow flowers, which are highly fragrant and attract pollinators. The health benefits of Ipomopsis aggregata var. maculata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an antispasmodic and a sedative, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
